modules.title: Summary
modules.instructions: A neutral summary of the interview in four or five sentences.

modules.title: Interview purpose
modules.instructions: One line, taken from the recording details.

modules.title: Participants
modules.instructions: Interviewer and interviewee as named in the details.

modules.title: Main themes
modules.instructions: One short paragraph per theme the interviewee spoke about, in their own terms.

modules.title: Key quotes
modules.instructions: Two or three remarks, word for word, with who said them.

modules.title: Highlights
modules.instructions: The highlights marked during the interview.

modules.title: Follow-up questions
modules.instructions: Questions left open that are worth asking next time.
